required_stages.description: Allocate a fresh (N,) output of input's dtype inside run().
One kernel pass that reads each element of input once and writes it once to position N - 1 - i of the output, with correct tail handling (no out-of-range or negative-index access is stored or read).

forbidden_substitutions.message: A PyTorch flip/gather replaces the whole computation.
Tensor-method flip/gather, a host copy, or a host-built index inside run() performs the reversal on the host.
Returning the input, a view of it, or a negative-stride view violates the fresh contiguous-output requirement.
No dtype conversion is allowed anywhere in reverse_array.
No initialised scratch or host-side copy is part of this operator.

required_evidence.message: No kernel-level store found; the reversal must be done by a kernel.
No mirrored index arithmetic or in-tile flip found inside the kernel.

outputs.aliasing: none; the returned (N,) tensor must be freshly allocated inside run(), contiguous, and must not share storage with input

timing_boundary.notes: Everything inside run() is timed: the output allocation and the single reversal kernel. No cached state, no host-side copy, index construction or conversion of input.
